rules_hit: 避开别的影子：小船长成身体而非人坐在船上。识别：短而鼓的船体，一叶还没张满的小帆。不普通：拿掉船就没有角色。材质只有一处船漆木。配色浅木白配深青船漆。新组合。特点夸张到整只身体就是还在找风的船。不做成行驶场面或沉船。

zh: 原创潮玩角色，一颗浅木圆核和一只还在找风向的小船长在一起：整艘短船就是它的身体，拿掉船就没有角色。一艘短而鼓的小船围成胸腹，船中一叶还没张满的软帆只扬起一半，船底两枚短钝足像轻轻搁浅。船头是一颗浅木圆核小头，几乎没有颈，略探出船沿，半睁小黑豆眼，极小一字嘴，视线平视前方。双足左右分开，船体平稳搁着，帆斜向一侧，像风还没定，先不必把事积着。主体是浅木短绒，只有船体外侧是一层深青船漆木，帆是更浅的米白。配色是浅木白配深青船漆。船没有破浪前行，没有沉没，帆没有被撕破。船身和帆上没有文字或数字。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，站在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要可阅读的文字和数字，不要颁奖奖杯，不要发光屏幕，不要锁链或伤口。
enp: Original designer toy character: a light-wood rounded core fused with a small boat still feeling for the wind — the boat is the body, without it there is no character. A short, puffed hull forms the torso, a soft sail in the middle raised only halfway, two short blunt feet below as if gently grounded. A light-wood rounded head sits at the bow, almost no neck, slightly over the gunwale, half-open tiny black bean eyes, a tiny straight mouth, gaze level ahead. Feet planted apart, the hull resting steady, the sail angled to one side, as if the wind is not decided yet and nothing has to be stored up. Body is light-wood plush; only the outer hull is deep-teal painted wood, the sail a paler rice-white. Colors: light wood-white with deep teal paint. The boat is not cutting through waves, not sinking, and the sail is not torn. No letters or numerals on the hull or sail. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, standing on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No readable letters or numerals, no award trophy, no lit screens, no chains or injuries.
